name: same-session-computer-use
description: Add task-owned window claims and exact background capture for Codex on Hyprland.

interface.shortDescription: Claimed background capture for Hyprland apps.
interface.longDescription: Extends the bundled Computer Use plugin on Hyprland with task-owned window claims, exact background capture, and task-owned coordinate fallback recovery. Exact capture and coordinate leases honor claims; targeted shortcuts and pointer controls retain their existing single-agent behavior.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in app to complete this task in the background.
Show me an exact screenshot of one of my real application windows.
Operate this app without moving my pointer or changing my workspace.
